title: Overall comparison
caption: Each model uses its existing frozen policy. Policies were selected differently; these are not equal-alert-budget comparisons. VIIRS defines the reference labels.

title: Precision–recall ranking
caption: Dots/squares show frozen operating points. Curves are diagnostic sweeps of saved scores; no new threshold was selected. V2 localization has a binary policy, so it is shown as a point only. VIIRS self-comparison is omitted from ranking curves.

title: Comparison at native MODIS-cell scale
caption: PLS MLP and hybrid use separately frozen validation cell policies; V2 preserves its native alert policy. The MLP cell comparator uses CPU float32 scores; its original query comparator used BF16. No saved tree cell policy exists, so none was fitted for this chart. Partial observed support is not a full physical footprint.

title: Shared scene: all models
caption: This display uses the test tile with the most positive labels; it is not a typical-scene claim. The crop includes the union of reference positives and all model alerts in that tile, with an eight-query margin. Maps use query indices, not a claim of finer measured thermal resolution.
